_comment: Illustrative only. Real contracts live at specs/<NNN-feature>/contract.v<N>.json. Paths are made up - adjust to your layout. Two hard rules: no two units may own the same path, and role=test units must be dispatchable before role=impl units.

units.title: EditMode coverage for queue reordering
units.instructions: Write failing tests first, straight from the spec scenarios. Cover empty queue, out-of-range index, and identity preservation. Do not touch production code.

units.title: Reducer support for queue reordering
units.instructions: Add a ReorderQueue action and reducer case. The reducer must preserve per-customer patience values by customer id, not by index. Do not modify view code.

units.title: QueueSystem applies reorder actions
units.instructions: Consume the ReorderQueue action emitted by the reducer. Emit exactly one state change per reorder. Keep the update loop allocation-free.
